ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde trust & safety / RydeHELP human reviewer: flag the driver's abusive chat message ("Shut up", 09:04) and the rider's stated safety concern for conduct review, and note the substantiated unexempted deviation (08:58–09:05, +3.75 km) for the concurrent overcharge review; do not auto-issue a refund.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1: driver chat message #2 at 09:04 contains a threat/intimidation keyword ("shut up" — "Shut up and let me drive."), and the rider states she "felt unsafe". Case is removed from automated adjudication and referred to a human reviewer. Reviewer note (not binding): the route-deviation claim is separately well founded — RD-1/RD-2/RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 support an extra-distance refund of $5.29, while RD-6 does not trigger.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 08:58–09:05, 4.39 km driven vs 0.64 km optimal, +3.75 km, up to 1034 m from the optimal route [F3]. No exemption under RD-4: no traffic incidents on the route in the trip window [F13]; only band 4 speeds [F11][F12] (not band 1/2), and RD-4(b) does not exempt alone; weather fair [F14]; driver's GPS assertion [F10] is not a RD-4 reasonable cause and is overridden by system records. No exemption under RD-3: no passenger-named stop or app destination change (only the rider's 09:03 query [F7]); RD-3(b) unilateral, undisclosed diversion. No exemption under RD-5: no driver-proposed route change before the diversion began at 08:58, and no passenger consent. Unreserved deviation → RD-1 violation; refundable extra distance $5.29 (3.75 km × $1.41/km) under RD-2, with the 0.45 km map-matching residue not refunded. (Superseded by the SAFE-1 escalation.)

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement 'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me; nothing wrong with the fare' is contradicted by the gps system records (20.1 km vs 15.9 km optimal; 08:58–09:05 segment adding 3.75 km) [F1][F3], and no traffic incident or band 1/2 congestion supports a reasonable-cause exemption [F11][F12][F13]. System records override statements.
